items.information: ## ![Español](https://i.ibb.co/R9FXtCV/spanish-flag.png) Español ## Bienvenido al Cubeando Ando Cojedes 2023 **Por favor leer todas las pestañas antes de registrarte, hay mucha información importante que debes saber, incluso si eres un competidor recurrente.** * Límite de **40 competidores** para el registro. * Es una competencia abierta, para competidores de cualquier edad y experiencia. * **Nuevos Competidores:** hemos creado una [pestaña exclusiva](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeandoAndoCojedes2023#36619-nuevos-competidores-new-competitor) para ustedes. Muy importante leerla. * Si tiene dudas, puede ver la pestaña de [Preguntas Frecuentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeandoAndoCojedes2023#36620-preguntas-frecuentes-faq) o contactar al equipo organizador. ## ![English](https://i.ibb.co/HT0yLMw/english-flag.png) English ## Welcome to Cubeando Ando Cojedes 2023 **Please read all the tabs before registering; there is a lot of important information you should know, even if you are a recurring competitor.** * Competitor registration limit: **40**. * It is an open competition, for competitors of any age and experience. * **New Competitors:** we have created an [exclusive tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeandoAndoCojedes2023#36619-nuevos-competidores-new-competitor) for you. It is very important to read it. * If you have any questions, you can check [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeandoAndoCojedes2023#36620-preguntas-frecuentes-faq) or contact the organizing team. ## **Información de Contacto / Contact Info:** • Enrymar Cisneros Teléfono: 0426-5335576 [WhatsApp](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=+584265335576&text=%C2%A1Hola%20Enrymar!%20Me%20gustar%C3%ADa%20obtener%20m%C3%A1s%20informaci%C3%B3n%20de%20la%20competencia%20*Cubeando%20Ando%20Cojedes%202023*) speedcubingvenezuela@gmail.com • Rafael Antonio Sánchez: Teléfono: 0412-8571331 [WhatsApp](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=+584128571331&text=%C2%A1Hola%20Rafael!%20Me%20gustar%C3%ADa%20obtener%20m%C3%A1s%20informaci%C3%B3n%20de%20la%20competencia%20*Cubeando%20Ando%20Cojedes%202023*) rafaelmachele@gmail.com

items.name: Folsom Winter 2023
items.information: Get ready for Folsom's first cubing competition! ### **Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.** **Competition Day Timing** - The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. - Lunch will end at the scheduled time. - Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

items.information: **¡Formá parte de este nuevo torneo!** Recordá que para participar es obligatorio estar familiarizado con el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) ¡Te necesitamos para seguir fortaleciendo nuestra comunidad! Involucrate con las diferentes tareas que nos ayudan a un torneo exitoso y agradable para todos, ya sea como juez, runner, scrambler, etc. Te dejamos links para más información a continuación: *[Reglas basicas sobre cómo competir](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8O_iWRGq4K8) *[Manual WCA para competidores](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/es/tutorial.pdf) *[Manual WCA para jueces](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/judge-tutorial/judge-tutorial-es.pdf) Te esperamos :) **Be part of this new tournament!** Remember that to participate it is mandatory to be familiar with the ["WCA Regulations"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) We need you to continue strengthening our community! Get involved with the different tasks that help us to have a successful and enjoyable tournament for everyone, be it as a judge, runner, scrambler, etc. We leave you links for more information below: *[Basics rules to compete](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) *[WCA competitor tutorial](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) *[WCA judging tutorial](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/judge-tutorial/judge-tutorial.pdf) See you there :) CLUB DE SPEEDCUBING PARAGUAY Email: speedcubingpy@gmail.com Facebook: /cscpy Instagram: @cscpy
